checks.detail: Original 2e-6 component gate and FAILED_PARTIAL outcome remain authoritative; no replacement budget, native attempt, or receiver merge is adopted.
Exact installed-byte equality is distinguished from unestablished source-to-binary lineage. Source facts are explicitly attached to pinned upstream commit32f5fdce0a0a571a39198edf8d7b5d719bf59f2c.
Native encoding/calculation is labeled the strongest supported inference, not causal replay or a demonstrated Blender defect; missing fan frames and encoded short pairs remain explicit.
Signed-short angular representation, approximate acos, quantization, near-auto shortcut and beta-zero shortcut agree with retained primary source.
Scalar calculations are used only to reject an incomplete universal error argument; they are not presented as a complete codec guarantee or a newly accepted budget.
Recorded NORMALS and merge_vertices=false match original observations. No untested setting is declared a fix and no claim rules out all alternatives.
Native shading normals, authoritative source normals, geometry passes and archival metadata are kept separate. Original normal retention would not conceal approximation in actual native shading.

Explicit-frame CPU characterization can be performed without Blender or inferred C211 internal state; completion permits a finite conditional counterexample or precise blocker rather than demanding global proof.
Native import/save/reopen/render acceptance remains separate and unrun. Future CPU task neither mutates held receiver nor approves a native attempt.

advisories.detail: Before implementing the next CPU harness, explicitly define valid-frame preconditions (finite unit orthonormal basis with documented handedness and angular ranges). Keep wrapper rejection of nonfinite/degenerate inputs distinct from what the upstream low-level codec defines. A pair of supplied sharp-boundary frames tests independent corner preservation, not native fan construction.

scope_limits: Review covers the five bound decision documents and native-source/mechanism boundary, not packaging or publication.
Numerical recomputation/control-method review is owned by the separate evidence worker.
